items.title: DropdownMenu primitive available
items.expected: DropdownMenu module resolves; frontend typecheck includes it with exit 0.
items.evidence: 2026-07-29: dep present in frontend/package.json (^2.1.24); ui/dropdown-menu.tsx present; npm --prefix frontend run typecheck exit 0.

items.title: Full-width three-zone header
steps: Confirm header spans the browser width (not capped with main at 680px)
Confirm brand is on the far left
Confirm Home and Friends icons sit in the visual center of the window
Confirm Messages, Notifications, and Profile sit on the far right
items.expected: Left / center / right zones match the spec ASCII; main content remains narrow.
items.evidence: AppShell uses grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] full-width header; main remains max-w-[680px]. Primary nav = Feed+Friends; Account = Messages·Notifications·Profile. Preview served http://localhost:5181/ (HTTP 200) for author review before -d.

items.title: Profile dropdown — open and Profile link
steps: Click the Profile icon in the right cluster
Confirm menu lists Profile, Switch mode, Log out
items.expected: Menu opens; Profile item lands on the signed-in user's profile page.
items.evidence: AppShell DropdownMenu items: Profile (Link to profilePath), Switch mode, Log out. Profile path `/u/${username||me}`. Author previewed on :5181 before -d.

items.title: Profile dropdown — Switch mode
steps: Confirm document theme class / appearance flips
items.expected: Theme toggles and persists via existing theme storage; no standalone moon/sun icon in the signed-in header row.
items.evidence: Menu item calls useTheme().toggleTheme(); ThemeToggle only rendered in signed-out branch. Persistence remains ThemeContext/localStorage path from plan 10.

items.title: Profile dropdown — Log out
steps: Confirm session ends (signed-out chrome / login path)
items.expected: Logout works; no separate Log out button remains in the signed-in header row.
items.evidence: Signed-in Log out is DropdownMenuItem → logout(); no outline Log out Button in signed-in cluster.

items.title: Right-cluster order and badges
items.precondition: Signed in; ideally with at least one badge non-zero if available
steps: Read right-cluster order: Messages, Notifications, Profile
Confirm Home still shows feed badge behavior when count > 0
Confirm Messages / Notifications badges still render when counts > 0
items.expected: Order matches spec; badge plumbing unchanged.
items.evidence: Account cluster order Messages → Notifications → Profile trigger. NavIcon badge props still wired to feedCount/messagesCount/notificationCount; unread poll effect unchanged.

items.title: Signed-out header cluster
steps: Confirm ThemeToggle and Sign in appear on the right
items.expected: Signed-out chrome keeps ThemeToggle + Sign in; center Home may still show if rendered for guests per existing auth gating.
items.evidence: Signed-out branch renders ThemeToggle + Sign in Link; Profile DropdownMenu only inside user ? branch. Center still shows Feed NavIcon for all.
